Breakthroughs in artificial intelligence – led by the arrival of ChatGPT three years ago – have made the question of what it means to be human as vexed as ever, but the dictionary has drawn a firm line with its choice of the word of 2026, defining “human” as “having the qualities, faults, and feelings that people have, as opposed to gods, animals, or machines”. items.title: ‘Aarigaa!’: the triumph of Mary Peltola’s historic US Senate win and what it means for Alaska Natives
items.summary: Peltola, the first Alaska Native in the US Senate, ran a campaign that drew universal issues from her own Indigenous politics Late into the night on 3 November, while the lower 48 states were reeling from the blue wave crashing across the US, Mary Peltola took to the stage in a Sheraton hotel ballroom in Anchorage, Alaska, to greet her supporters. It wasn’t a victory speech as such – there would still be long days ahead before all votes could be counted across this vast Arctic state.
